title: MCP tool: blackbox report
goal: NERV's fpv.blackbox_report has a path through FPVBuddy
acceptance: A read-only MCP tool takes a blackbox log (inline text with a stated size cap, refused above it) and returns the F-014-T01 report; nothing is written or kept; specs cover a report, an oversize log and a malformed one; the consumer tool table lists it
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one stateless tool; how a large log reaches the server carries the uncertainty. Not a measurement.
